mapper.select: INSERT INTO agent (name, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}) RETURNING agent_id::text AS agent_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_agent_binding (tenant_id, agent_id, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{agentId}::uuid, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND b.status = 'ACTIVE'

INSERT INTO agent_version (agent_id, version_number, definition, published_at, created_at) SELECT #{agentId}::uuid, COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(version_number) FROM agent_version WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid ), 0) + 1, #{definition}::jsonb, now(), now() RETURNING version_id::text AS version_id, version_number, created_at, published_at, definition::text AS stored_definition
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_snapshot (version_id, agent_config, prompt_config, tool_contracts, run_config, context_policy) VALUES (#{versionId}::uuid, #{agentConfig}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb, #{runConfig}::jsonb, #{contextPolicy}::jsonb)
